title: Creating a Golden Source of Truth for Corporate Actions | Jonathan Ehrenfeld, Sergey Nazarov
description:
View the full discussion: https://youtu.be/x_D1MM_0EGQ

Swift’s Head of Strategy Jonathan Ehrenfeld and Chainlink Co-Founder Sergey Nazarov discuss how blockchains, oracle networks, and AI are making it possible to solve “an intractable problem”: creating a golden source of truth for corporate actions.

Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi. 

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link.

✅ Subscribe and turn notifications on: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnjkrlqaWEBSnKZQ71gdyFA?sub_confirmation=1

Learn more about Chainlink:

Website: https://chain.link
Docs: https://docs.chain.link
Twitter: https://twitter.com/chainlink

#Chainlink #crypto #blockchain

asr.full_text: It's one of these things that everybody thinks is a good idea, but nobody dares to take the responsibility to build a golden record because the liabilities of saying I have the single version of the truth. It's very dangerous, right? Because remember that in corporate actions there is data that especially asset managers take to take investment decisions. If you get it wrong, the problems are huge, right? So I think, what we see now, is that by using blockchain networks and AI together, then there is this hope that building this golden record could be, because of the native capabilities of a blockchain, that it is basically a single version of the truth. That people will dare to start talking more about GoldenSource. If you used to talk about GoldenSource maybe five years ago or 10 years ago, people will say, like, don't touch that, you know, nobody wants to build it, nobody wants to maintain it. I think now that's changing and that's what maybe will do what is going to be the missing piece of the puzzle. Right, right. So you're basically saying that it was very difficult to build a single authoritative golden source of truth. Correct. And then getting it wrong has very large consequences. And so, what you were saying is that it was such an intractable problem that when people 5 or 10 years ago brought it up and said hey I can give you a single validated Golden Source about this for example corporate Actions topic it was it was such an intractable problem that people you know didn't even want to engage but now what you're seeing is that Oracle Networks together with AI together with blockchain networks you know have have a good chance of solving the problem. Yeah, correct, I mean, it's still a tricky thing, but I do think that it's something that, because is a very old problem that nobody has find a solution that is sustainable, it is a problem that is worth trying to solve it now with technology that it's capable of doing it.

Although it includes Chainlink-related informational links and promotional language, the available video evidence does not describe a required payment, data submission, investment participation, guaranteed return, or deceptive outcome.
